player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} oo ciyaaraya ciyaar shaashad ah sida {color}. Dhaqdhaqaaqaaga ku samee calaamadda qaabka shaashadda [fileRank fileRank], tusaale ahaan '[b2c3]' (xarafka tiirka ah, lambar safka 07). Xeerarka aasaasiga ah: • Si gees ah u dhaqaaq 1 haddii ay madhan tahay. • Qabashada adigoo ka boodaya gabal ka soo horjeeda. • Qalabka waa boqor haddii uu gaaro dhamaadka ka soo horjeeda.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ma jiro qaab wareejin oo sax ah oo la helay. Isticmaal [a1b2], tusaale ahaan [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Casaanku ma haysto wax jajab ah oo uu ka haray. madowgu wuu guuleystay!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Madowga wax jaad ah ma haysan, casaankuna wuu guuleystay!
outcome.no_moves: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ma laha wax dhaqaaq ah oo haray.
